summary: AkzoNobel furnished a 6-K with a media release announcing European Commission conditional approval of its proposed all-stock merger of equals with Axalta Coating Systems (NYSE:AXTA). The remedy is divestment of AkzoNobel's European vehicle refinish business, resolving horizontal overlap in the EEA, UK and Switzerland; no other competition issues were flagged. Combined revenue is roughly $17 billion. Close is expected in early 2027, pending remaining regulatory approvals. Poux-Guillaume becomes CEO and Villavarayan Deputy CEO of the combined entity. Watch residual jurisdictions and any remedy-buyer process, which could shift the arbitrage spread.
